executive_summary: No dated fashion-calendar event fell inside this collection window (August 11-17, 2026): Copenhagen Fashion Week SS27 closed August 7, and the next scheduled events -- the CFDA's preliminary September 2026 NYFW schedule and Oslo Runway/Argentina Fashion Week in late August -- both sit outside it. Targeted search again could not surface dated post-Copenhagen recap, review, or street-style coverage specifically datelined to that show, now two collection windows after it closed; the CFDA NYFW schedule announcement search results returned kept resolving to a July 2026 publish date, outside this window, and are excluded on that basis rather than counted as an in-window finding. The one signal carried forward from the August 10 report -- a peplum/exaggerated-waistline and basque-waist silhouette direction -- was rechecked per that report's own recommendation; it remains uncorroborated by any dated post-Copenhagen source. Two windows of silence on that specific question starts to look less like an ordinary one-to-two-week recap lag and more like a gap in what this project's search tooling can reach, and is logged as such rather than treated as a confirmed non-event. The sheer-layering and soft-tailoring dormancy checks (last logged August 3, both 'declining') were spot-checked again and remain surrounded only by undated evergreen guide content; they are not re-logged. This is the fourth consecutive thin report (July 27, August 3, August 10, August 17) -- a run worth naming plainly rather than letting each week read as an isolated shortfall; see limitations and archive_tags.
